g.title: j1118914776
g.text: H16h V0l7463: ::clears throat:: ahem ahem! ATTENTION ALL! Invitations to one and all to the Hexiest Pizza Party known to tastebuds.

g.text: xX GLIMMER Xx: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED> amir hold on i didn’t finish the poster…!

g.title: j822528682
g.text: Belladonna ~{@: I think I have enough antacids for this
I *think*

g.title: j1442509922
g.text: Soldja1Shot1kil: u think the people will feel welcome? eleanor not scarin’ them away w her bite? lol ;)

g.title: j201476664
g.text: Broadsword: Focus. Is everything ready?

g.title: j955950074
g.text: Yes, we can open this place to civvies.

g.title: j1883268972
g.text: Civvies should have heard that this is somewhere under Hex protection.

g.title: j149783608
g.text: I hope civvies come, we have to give them anything to look forward to.

g.text: H16h V0l7463: more newbies to milk coins from. sweet, sweet coins.

g.title: j3909897930
g.text: xX GLIMMER Xx: ewiw. gross Amir.

g.title: j3196957322
g.text: xX GLIMMER Xx: but - more people! maybe we should welcome them with a playlist? what song should we put on?

g.title: j2413118209
g.text: Let’s do Party of your Lifetime.

g.title: j1828651475
g.text: Oh, ‘The Call’, love it.

g.title: j844103755
g.text: Let’s be ironic, how about ‘Rotten Lives’.

g.title: j2100392999
g.text: Belladonna ~{@: Enough chatter
¡Vamos! Let’s get moving
Can't wait to talk to someone about something other than Arthur’s fighting stance

g.title: j1305733502
g.text: Salem: Oh Lettie, we *all* know you could take him.

g.title: j530758399
g.text: xX GLIMMER Xx: lettie? u mean it? u actually sound excited! <RETRO_EMOJI_JOY>

g.title: j2926072445
g.text: Broadsword: Right, I’m opening the mall. No turning back. No second guessing. Remember: it means something to these people to have somewhere to feel safe. But we can do better. Let’s have fun again.
